scope: Post-selection common true-power epigraph polishing, 12 iterations, exactly zero auxiliary weight. Dense final audit used for evaluation and explicit post-run validation selection; never fed back to optimization. Sensitivity is exploratory extra work, not counted in initial 80-iteration budget.

reflection_zero.meaning: Opposite thickness perturbations produce nearly pi phase flip at negligible power: arg(r) is ill-conditioned.

incompatible_phase_targets.meaning: Opposite pointwise guide phases are a search bias, generally not an independently realizable specification.
